verdict.rationale: Vercel publishes an official v0 SDK in the vercel/v0-sdk repository. It has documented client usage (`v0.chats.create`), stream helpers (`readV0Stream`) and auth via V0_API_KEY or Vercel OIDC, and it sits on top of a v0 Platform API that exposes v0's generation, chat, project and deployment features. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond a single JavaScript/TypeScript package, in-depth SDK reference docs or versioning detail, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Set V0_API_KEY, or deploy server-side code on Vercel with OIDC enabled, then use the default client.

The v0 API gives you programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities, letting you integrate v0's AI-powered code generation, chat interface, project management, and deployment features into your own applications and workflows.
